events.description: Adult £50 | Child (5-17) £41 | Infant £20 Includes: Transportation, entry into Kenilworth Castle and free time to explore Stratford-Upon-Avon. Discover the enchanting allure of Kenilworth Castle, with its striking red, sandstone towers, keep, and walls that shimmer beautifully in the soft light of dawn and dusk. Uncover its intriguing ties to Henry V while enjoying a peaceful walk through the charming Tudor gardens. Then, make your way to the literary hub of England and dive into the delightful market town that is the birthplace of the iconic William Shakespeare. *English Heritage Members: Ask

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit the Military Personnel Flight within required timelines. Use the official newcomers page for RAF Lakenheath reporting instructions.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Office before arrival for on-base waitlists and off-base referrals. Temporary lodging is available through the base lodging office where offered.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival and assist with base orientation. Contact your gaining unit if no sponsor is assigned before departure.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource, Military.com, and BaseDirectory for relocation support.
